articleTitle: Information Technology as the Basis for Transformation into a Digital Society and Industry 5.0
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Currently, the industry is transforming the physical world of real things into their “virtual copies”. This transformation is a key element of industry 4.0. Due to the high requirements of end users to the individualization of the purchased product industry 5.0 is becoming increasingly popular concept, which implies the penetration of artificial intelligence into the human life to increase the level of human capabilities. The article discusses the state and prospects of development of technologies that contribute in the process of the transition from industry 4.0 to industry 5.0. The conditional pyramid of technologies which Association is capable to provide this transition is presented. New types of distributed computers, Internet of everything, multi-agent systems and technologies, ontology and knowledge bases, theory of complex adaptive systems, emergent intelligence, evergetic and enterprise architecture are considered as the main components for the transition. Boundary calculations in the context of management of data coming from the Internet of things will affect almost all companies in the economy and the public sector. They will cover the scope of activities from the automation of throughput control and data collection on the quality of goods, monitoring of vehicle traffic and ending with the robotization of factories. The article presents an analysis of modern and promising technologies necessary for the organization of the digital industry in enterprises, and determining the set of necessary technologies that ensure the transition from the current state of the industry to Industry 4.0 and then to Industry 5.0. It also presents a formal description of industry 4.0 and industry 5.0, which makes it possible to present the problem as a mathematical problem that has a solution. Complex formal description of the enterprise, based on the methodology of its architecture, allows to increase the efficiency of business information support in the industry 5.0. This is necessary for the organization of the digital industry in enterprises and to determine how to ensure the transition from the current state of the industry to industry 5.0. Applying this approach to industry 4.0, then to Industry 5.0, will measure the cost of this transition and make it effective.

articleTitle: Integration of Quality Management and Digital Technologies
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The development of digital technologies leads to a change of views on modern production. Most methods and tools of quality management use the element of analysis of the results and subsequent (with a delay in time) decision-making. This approach has not recently caused much inconvenience, but now the delay in taking the necessary corrective action can reduce the competitiveness of the organization. Modern information technologies allow to integrate quality management into technological processes and to manage quality in real time.

articleTitle: Review of Existing Consensus Algorithms Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In recent years, blockchain technology has begun to attract close attention. The blockchain solved the problem of replacing the original centralized ledger with a low level of trust, on a decentralized form with a high level of trust, which has various objects, or, in other words, checking nodes. The main feature of the blockchain technology is a consistent algorithm that decides how an agreement is reached on adding a new block between all nodes in the checking network. Blockchain algorithms can be divided into two main groups. There is consensus based on evidence. This group requires that nodes connecting to the inspection network show that they are more qualified than others to do the extra work. The second type is consensus, which is based on voting and requires that the nodes in the network exchange the results of the verification of a new block or transaction before making a final decision. This article provides an overview of existing blockchain consensus algorithms.

articleTitle: Development of the Application for Diploma Authenticity Using the Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Global digitalization of society implies the availability of information, as well as verification of its authenticity from anywhere in the world. Providing digital diplomas. the analogue of paper ones, is an actual task. In the current paper the step-by-step development of an application for authentication of diplomas using blockchain technology is considered. Also the concept, structures and operation mechanism of the blockchain are described.

articleTitle: Protection the Data Banks in State Critical Information Infrastructure Organizations
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Most state critical information infrastructure organizations have special data banks that contain confidential intelligence structures. This applies primarily to power supply companies, chemical enterprises, medical support and environmental monitoring organizations, science centers etc. Wherein storing data refer to personal information and state secret information. Defence of these data banks is state level strategic objective.

articleTitle: Analysis of Monitoring Data on the Criteria of Technogenic Safety in Project Activities
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Monitoring and control over the criteria of technogenic safety is carried out on the basis of a man-machine system in the design of technical systems with the participation of a group of experts in various fields of knowledge. Teamwork is carried out on the basis of multi-agent technologies in a distributed information environment for processing and transmitting information. The aim of the study is to identify a generalized indicator (a criterion of technological safety) - the degrees of risk used to take into account the possibility of the emergence of technological situations.

articleTitle: Criteria for Selecting Optimal Locating Charts of the Workpiece in Process Engineering
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The method of multi-criteria selection of optimal locating charts in solving the problem of single technological processes synthesis is considered. The criteria for selecting optimal locating charts are proposed and the method of evaluating each criterion is given.

articleTitle: An Analysis of the Use and Difficulties in Introducing Information Technology and Information Systems in Transport and the Transport Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the problems associated with the widespread introduction of digital and information technologies in various sectors of the economy of the Russian Federation, including in the transport and logistics sector. Digitalization and informatization of the transport complex, logistics processes that were perceived not so long ago as something far from reality, today are the basis of modern transport business processes prove their necessity and efficiency. The paper analyzes various informational technical transport systems (ITS) of transport and transport infrastructure management, and shows that the implementation process is not quite systematic on Russian roads. It is shown that the lack of common standards and technological platforms leads to the emergence of a number of problems, such as electromagnetic and information incompatibility, unacceptable threats and risks, cyber security, organizational disunity, inconsistency and chaos of ITS management. It is shown that to create and ITS transport industry, it is necessary to promote a unified set of standards, a single technological platform, use the principles of system engineering and build an IT architecture and infrastructure. Not timely adoption of integration measures may further lead to a traffic collapse, or Russia's lag in the development of intelligent transport and transport infrastructure.

articleTitle: Multi-agent Programming Technology as the Instrument of Operational Management Systems Implementation in Pilot Production
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article describes the basic concept of using the multi-agent system as the instrument to solve the problem of introducing an operational management system in pilot (experimental) production. The target functions, the main program architecture elements of the multi-agent system and the principles of their interaction are the subject of the separate research and demand a more detailed description.

articleTitle: Automatic Control of the Sustainability of Digital Transformation Processes in the Digital Economy
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: An approach to creating the information space of the digital economy is proposed, the basis of which is the theory of automatic control and the theory of information processes and systems. The processes of sustainable development are formulated and investigated using the apparatus of transfer functions. The threshold values of the characteristics of the subjects of the socio-economic system of large dimension, providing damping in risk scenarios of development, are established.

articleTitle: Some Approaches to the Formalization Principles of Achieving the Target Properties of Products in the Automation of Technological Processes in Mechanical Engineering
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: computer aided instruction; teaching; educational institutions; educational courses; quality control; quality management; Internet; learning (artificial intelligence); security of data; neural nets.

articleTitle: New Methods of Science Popularization in the Social Media: Modern Trends and Communications
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The problem of scientific and science popular blogging in the information web- space and its key features are considered and illustrated by the example of Instagram social network in the present article.

articleTitle: Method of Converting an Induction Motor to a Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (Ls-Pmsm) with Linear Starting Using FEA for Mechatronic Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article describes basic overview of retrofit design flow of line start permanent magnet synchronous machine. Developed design methodology involves extensive usage of finite element analysis. Four strategies of rotor modification are present in this paper to provide cheap and efficient solution. Preliminary calculations showed positive results.

articleTitle: Automatic Quality Control of Processes in the Online Educational Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The concept of an educational online platform is proposed. A technology has been developed to control the quality of information resources. Evaluation of the quality of processes is carried out on the basis of comparing the likelihood ratio with a threshold that depends on losses in making right or false decisions and a priori probabilities of hypotheses. The calculation of losses when making decisions according to the Neumann-Pearson criterion for equal mean values and unequal variances of the results of observations was carried out. The solutions obtained are implemented in the system of computer definition of acquired competencies.

articleTitle: The Management and Automation of Manufacturing Processes
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Along with manufacturers of similar products, organizations are increasingly being formed, which are a complex, multi-level system of organization processes. Today, for such organizations, the topic of integrated management and control of production of products or services, as well as ensuring automation of production processes, is becoming more relevant. Instrumental methods and means of control of production processes are regarded in the article, allowing a comprehensive analysis of the state of processes, the possibility of making changes and their improvement. The analysis of methods and means of control of production processes is considered in the article along with the possibility of applying the subsequent automation of production processes.

articleTitle: Organization of Information Security in Industrial Internet of Things Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Different approaches to providing security in IIoT systems of the enterprises with the use of basic methods of information protection and equipment are shown. The possibilities of use of different structure variants, network technologies and cryptographic methods are shown. Different variants of use of the solutions, described in article, are presented. The results can be useful to designers and administrators of IIoT systems.

articleTitle: Development of an Application for Car License Plates Recognition Using Neural Network Technologies
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The abstract task of recognizing vehicle license plates one from another has become relevant with the general increase of number of vehicles. There were 373 cars per 1,000 people in Russia in 2018. Identification of the vehicle number can be used for various purposes: control of traffic rules, automatic calculation of fines, control of movement of a specific vehicle, etc. There are many solutions to the problem of recognizing the license plate number, including online services. The recognition level of existing tools allows you to fully automate this process and achieve a high level of recognition accuracy. The most promising approach to solving this problem is the use of neural network technologies. This article discusses the development of an application for license plate recognition using neural network technologies.

articleTitle: Selection of Tools of Automation of Business Processes of a Manufacturing Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article describes the methodology for calculating the quality assessment of project documentation at a manufacturing enterprise in the energy sector using a process management approach. To simplify the work of enterprise employees, a method has been proposed to automate processes using the object-oriented programming language Visual Basic for Application and the Business Studio software for modeling business processes, as well as for collecting and further analyzing the values of indicators. Integration of two Microsoft Excel and Business Studio software products has been implemented. Data analysis was carried out on the basis of real values obtained as a result of a survey of employees of the design and quality management departments, and measures were developed to optimize the information and analytical support of the enterprise. The choice of software products for the implementation of the proposed methodology is substantiated. This study examines both theoretical and practical aspects of optimizing the business processes of a manufacturing enterprise. In the course of the study, international and state standards of the quality management system, internal local standards of the enterprise were studied. The newest technologies were applied to improve the quality management system at the enterprise, a plan was developed to simplify and automate the main business processes of the company based on the key objectives set by the management.

articleTitle: Development of an Application for Vehicle Classification Using Neural Networks Technologies
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Nowadays, millions of people use the car as a mean of transport on a daily basis, whether it is taxi or personal transport. The automotive industry is actively developing, and more people are using the products of their activities. The number of car owners is increasing every day. Statistics show that every hour a new driver moves out in a brand new car. Detection of vehicles, mentioning categories of video data sequence, is an important but challenging task in terms of observing city traffic. The main difficulty of this task is that it requires the accurate localization of relatively small vehicles in complex scenes and must detect them in real time. The paper discusses the development of an application for the classification of vehicles in a video stream using neural network technologies.

articleTitle: Classification Algorithms Analysis in the Forest Fire Detection Problem
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The development of information technology allows applying complex mathematical algorithms. For example, machine learning (ML) procedures are used in almost all humans life areas: smart home systems, online recommendation systems intelligent chatbots and so on. This creates a huge demand for specialists in data analysis and ML. Modern data analysis packages often do not require deep knowledge from a specialist, which allows to apply all ML algorithms without a deep understanding of their work. However, the main problem is that the data is not suitable for the algorithm and as a result, the algorithm cannot detect all the patterns or does it incorrectly. This situation can be acceptable in pet projects and is completely unacceptable in cases where the algorithm error costs a lot of money or human lives. In this paper the analysis of ML algorithms and the possibility of their application to forest fires data are done.

articleTitle: Development of an Application for Localization and Recognition of Road Signs Using Neural Network Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In the current paper the development of the application for localization and recognition of road signs using neural network technology is considered.

Author Keywords: recognition of objects in the image

articleTitle: Integrated Quality Management Systems in an Innovative Transport Company
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Modern quality management systems are based on the concept of a systems approach that enables one to combine into a single node all possible aspects of a company activity. These systems, which use digital technologies extensively, turn an innovative transport company into a modern and efficient world-class enterprise.

articleTitle: The Use of Modern Information Technology in Predicting the Process of Impregnating Composite Preforms with Polymer Resins
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper describes the development of automated system for modeling resin frontal spread during the impregnation of fibrous reinforcing agent with regard to resin viscosity and impregnation time. The topicality of the paper is due to the necessity to provide the quality of composite materials by managing a technological process. The method of modeling boundaries of resin spread during reinforcing agent impregnation on the basis of an artificial neural network is offered. A number of experimental studies on a resin spread process in the volume of reinforcing agent, allowing to make a data base for training neural network model, is made. The developed neural network model allows to forecast the specific features of a composite material product impregnation process with regards to rheokinetics of the process.

articleTitle: Stages of Information Systems Development in the Context of Educational Mobility Formation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article discusses historical and logical analysis of the stages of e-technologies development for educational mobility. The paper presents tendencies of educational mobility development and current problems that motivate the development of SMART-technologies and augmented reality systems.

articleTitle: Software Complex of Biometric Identification Based on Neural Network Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article describes the development of a security facial recognition system for the university. Analyzed the latest solutions in the field of recognition and identification of persons. The software and hardware architecture of the developed system, the methods incorporated in the recognition program are described. Examples of the program implementation faces 2D-Recognition with Viola-Johns method and Neural Networks deep learning are given.

Author Keywords: deep learning Hc entrance control system

articleTitle: The Neuron Network Model of Human Personality for Use in Robotic Systems in Medicine and Biology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Operator is the important element of the robotic systems used in medicine and biology. In the robotic systems the model of the personality can be used instead of human operator. The model of the personality was designed for use in robotic systems in medicine and biology. The subject is the human personality. The goal is design of the model of human personality. The method is modeling. The model was developed with the use of the artificial neural networks. The artificial neural networks are designed on the base of switches architecture. The artificial neural networks used additional devices-the switchers to interconnect neurons and to store the training results in the memory. The artificial neural networks used initial training and forward training on the base of the genetic algorithms. The results of the neuron network training can be imported from and exported to other robotic systems.

articleTitle: Prototype of Driver Fatigue Detection System Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Driver fatigue is one of the major causes of accidents in the world. Detecting the drowsiness of the driver is one of the surest ways of measuring driver fatigue. In this paper we aim to develop a prototype drowsiness detection system. Presents a method for detecting the early signs of fatigue/drowsiness during driving. Analysing some environmental variables, it is possible to detect the loss of alertness prior to the driver falling asleep. This system works by monitoring the eyes of the driver and sounding an alarm when he/she is drowsy. As a result of this analysis, the system will determine if the subject is able to drive.

articleTitle: Automatic Analysis of Medical Images Based on Fractal Methods
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Analysis of changes in medical images is one of the most important areas of computer use, which ensures the progress of the diagnostic process at the moment. Along with the quality of visualization, automated diagnostic methods are being developed, CADs are being increasingly used. Today, medical imaging is the most common diagnostic tool in modern medical practice. The most relevant areas for the implementation of medical image analysis in connection with the specificity of the objects under study are methods based on mathematical methods for processing input information, for example, on a fractal analysis (analysis of self-similarity of image parts), which can be realized by calculating the fractal dimension and Hurst index. The obtained data in world practice become the basis for creating new algorithms for qualitative analysis and image processing for creating new algorithms.

articleTitle: Features of Development of Control Programs by Means of the Modular Description of Elementary Forms
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The features of the design of control programs for CNC machines using parametric programming are presented. The proposed unified method of obtaining the model of the processing elements described by the macro. The principles of building fragments of control programs for structural elements of the part with the introduction of processing conditions in the working code are formed.

articleTitle: Online Education: Pros and Cons
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In an age of constant development of technology and rapid changes, teachers have not only to monitor the changes and be in trend, but also try to succeed in it, they need to apply innovations to their work as efficiently as possible and be able to choose the tool that would meet the needs of both the student and teachers. Today, an increasing number of people is studying online. This is the result of the fact that the times of fierce competition have come, when specialists are forced to master new tools and technologies in order to outpace competitors. Thus, in spite of a number of advantages that distance learning gives, it also leads to certain difficulties, with which one must be able to work, and has a number of disadvantages that must be eliminated in order to obtain the maximum effect.

articleTitle: Formation of a Student's Digital Competencies Based on a Digital Footprint
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article discusses the conditions of training for the digital economy. These issues are becoming relevant due to the fact that Russia's transition to a new technological structure - to a digital economy requires the training of competent personnel. Solving this problem is impossible without changing the approach to teaching citizens, which requires modernizing the modern education system and vocational training, bringing educational programs in line with the conditions and needs of the digital economy. Creating a digital educational environment (DEE) requires the widespread introduction and effective use of digital tools of training activities, their holistic inclusion in the information environment, ensuring the preparation and training of citizens on an individual curriculum throughout their lives, namely at any time and in any place.

articleTitle: On the Influence of a Three-phase Protective Circuit Breaker Contacts Vibration on an Asynchronous Drive
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: If circuit breaker contacts are affected by vibration, then due to nonlinear dependence of the transitional contact resistance on the magnitude of the contact-compressing force, the harmonic composition of currents flowing through the contact connection changes. The paper presents a numerical estimation of this nonlinearity effect on parameters of a three-phase asynchronous drive.

articleTitle: Embedded Multiphysical Track Diagnostic Systems for Intelligent Transport
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Intellectual technologies in railway transport solve many urgent problems. The most important of these is ensuring safety of cargo and passenger traffic. Now its solution is entirely entrusted to specialized manual and self-propelled diagnostic tools. However, it is generally agreed that the most future-proof concept is installation of monitoring systems directly on regularly travelling trains. This approach will allow continuous monitoring of the railway tracks, and make forecasting the development of defective rails possible. This paper is devoted to the concept of embedded track monitoring systems based on inertial, optical, magnetic, satellite and other technologies. The main emphasis is placed on the analysis of signals of micromechanical inertial modules installed on the wheels of the car wheels, which allow monitoring the condition of the rolling surfaces of the rails. Based on the results of the analysis, a conclusion is made on possible configurations of the proposed embedded diagnostic systems.

articleTitle: The Method of the Cryptographic Information Protection in IT -Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The subject is the information communication in IT- systems. The goal is the information protection. The method used is the cryptography with secret key. The information is transferred between the devices in IT-system. The open communication channels are used. The information protection used the symmetric method of block enciphering. The cryptographic information security method used the block ciphering with the secret key. The secret key is appended by the random information. The number of digits in the secret key increased to the information block size. The cryptographic hack becomes impossible.

articleTitle: Modeling of Three-Phase Circuits by Means of MatLab in Electrical Engineering Course
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The use of information technologies provides developing and facilitating the process of teaching students in the field of electrical engineering. Besides the analytical modeling of electrical circuits, software implementation can be included in the electrical circuit analysis. This approach ensures the decrease of computational cost, as well as enables to investigate circuits in different regimes and to compare results obtained by analytical and numerical modeling. The paper is devoted to the numerical modeling of three-phase circuits studied in the electrical engineering course. The mentioned modeling is carried out in the MatLab system with using the Simscape library.

articleTitle: Recommendations to Ensure the Circuit's Safety in the Peripheral Reengineering of the Printed Circuit Configuration in the Information Security Management System of the Radio-Electronic Industry Companies
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The conceptual technology of peripheral circuit analysis of the configuration of the printed circuit of a radio-electronic device is reviewed. Fundamental differences between in-circuit and peripheral analysis are considered. It is shown that the JTAG-testing technology use in peripheral circuit analysis tasks creates an alternative to the system research of digital circuits. Major design and technological recommendations are proposed and formulated for ensuring circuit safety in the peripheral reengineering of the printed circuit configuration in the information management security system of radio-electronic industry companies.

articleTitle: On Some Methods for Correcting Accelerometer and Gyroscope Data Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article is devoted to the development of an intelligent system for monitoring the characteristics of the movement of vehicles. In the frame of the article a classifier was developed that allows to correct accelerometer and gyroscope data.

articleTitle: Higher Education Today: Mass or Individual Approach
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In modern society higher education has become one of the most sought-after spheres of human activity, regarded as a leading factor in the social and economic progress of the country and the personal growth of the individual. Individualization in higher education is not a new trend in the existing traditional education system, but a necessary condition for building a new modern and effective education system. On the other hand, in the conditions of a constantly changing, technologies, economic models, social institutions and public norms, higher education begins to undergo significant changes and becomes widespread in terms of using online platforms. In the article, the authors, based on an analysis of the advantages and disadvantages of mass and individual education, as well as the world best practices, suggested a combined model for the joint use of mass and individual education technologies to form the most popular educational programs and courses.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Feature Extraction Algorithms in Investigation of Products Sales Data
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The problem of determining the significant characteristics in the observations of the studied objects is considered. A comparative analysis of feature extraction algorithms is carried out, including correlation methods, methods using chi-square criterion, recursive feature exclusion methods and algorithms based on an ensemble of forests of random decision trees (algorithmic descriptions have been formalized according to the subject area). The results of the algorithms - the group of the most important goods characteristics - are additionally analyzed, namely, the selected features are compared: which signs (characteristics of the goods) were chosen by all algorithms and which were not (are there any intersections among the results). With the help of an expert group, we answered the question whether there are any contradictions in the results.

articleTitle: Elimination of Losses in Information Services Based on Approaches of IT-Service Management
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The formation of tools and techniques for continuous improvement of processes and services based on formalized and automated approaches is important in the context of the need to optimize operating costs for information services for businesses, as well as to improve the quality of IT services provided and to achieve the business goals of the IT complex of companies. To identify and eliminate losses in operating activities, it is proposed to use the methodology of the process approach and lean production tools, taking into account the features of technological processes of information services.

articleTitle: Development of the Research Stand «Smart City Systems» INDUSTRY 4.0
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The authors are developing a hardware and software complex that combines the operating layouts of various systems of the “Smart City”: transport, housing and public utilities, industry, agriculture. Sensors and actuators of the layout programmatically interact with each other and with the dispatcher's console via data exchange modules using various wired and wireless communication protocols. The dispatcher's console includes hardware modules for receiving data using various wired and wireless communication protocols; PC, software package for centralized data exchange between the stand modules.

articleTitle: Unsupervised Training of Automatic Dialogue Systems for Customer Support
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Automated dialog systems for customer support have recently become a popular area of research in the field of natural language processing. The traditional (supervised) approach for training the dialog model for customer support includes: (1) building a tree of topics (states), (2) finding query examples for each state, (3) training the classifier. This is an expensive, labor-intensive process. In contrast, we trained our dialog model in an unsupervised way, avoiding the need for labeled corpora. Our dialog model is retrieval-based, and its architecture incorporates a siamese network similar to the Dual Encoder. Similar to other retrieval-based dialog models, our model attempts to find the best response out of provided ones for the current dialog history. The research we performed provided the opportunity to develop a customer service solution - software that acts as an intelligent assistant, suggesting a list of relevant prompts to the operator in real time.

articleTitle: Recommendations to Ensure the Circuit's Safety in the In-Circuit Reengineering of the Printed Circuit Configuration in the Information Security Management System of the Radio-Electronic Industry Companies
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The conceptual technology of in-circuit circuit analysis of the configuration of the printed circuit of a radio-electronic device is reviewed including in-circuit measurements of the device radio-technical characteristics. It is shown that the in-circuit analysis does not involve the dismantling of the printed circuit board or the breaking of the electrical circuits connections in the basic circuit arrangement of functional modules in the printed circuit structure. The in-circuit analysis allows for the selective formation of a list of elements in the device without the risk of electrical damage to radio elements of the structure. Major design and technological recommendations are proposed and formulated for ensuring circuit safety in the in-circuit reengineering of the printed circuit configuration in the information management safety system of radio-electronic industry companies.

articleTitle: Specific Modes of Formation of Dynamic States for Robotic Systems and their Control Systems, Taking into Account the Connectivity of Movements in Two Coordinates
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article focuses on possibilities of dynamic damping of oscillations in mechanical systems with two degrees of freedom with simultaneous action of two forces. It investigates the features of the dynamic interactions of the system elements in terms of functional relationships between the existing external influences. It is shown that in cases where it is possible to vary the coefficients of the linear relationship between external influences, special dynamic damping modes can be created for which the necessary conditions for zeroing the oscillation amplitude in each coordinate are simultaneously satisfied. The authors determine restrictions on the form of external influences, which ensure the implementation of the modes of simultaneous dynamic damping of oscillations in a linear mechanical oscillatory system with two degrees of freedom. This method has a direct impact on the safety of robotic and technological complexes.

articleTitle: Building Corporate Quality Management Systems at Russian Automotive Corporations
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Set of models which widen capabilities of digital manufacturing management systems was created. Additions to the content of Russian standardized documentation for continuous improvement of product and process quality in accordance with IATF 16949 are proposed. The indicator of achieving the planned volume of profit in managing each project for preproduction and new product manufacture is adopted as the main criterion of efficiency. Mechanisms of forecasting and preventing significant potential profit losses during the project stages are proposed. Documentation has been developed to manage the delivery of commodity product, maintain the potential of the equipment, as well as to manage impact on the natural environment.

articleTitle: Mathematical Assessment of Uncertainty in Strategic Potential of Electrotechnical Industry
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article describes the method of mathematical assessment of uncertainty in the strategic management of an electrotechnical enterprise. A set of technogenic risk factors in the activities of the enterprise of electrotechnical industry is identified. On the basis of the identified set of risk factors, a game-theoretic model for predicting the impact of risks on the management process of the electrotechnical enterprise was implemented, on the basis of which an indicator was developed for assessing the technogenic risk of the strategic potential of the electrotechnical enterprise as a mathematical expectation of a discrete random variable. The probability of occurrence of a risk event is proposed to be determined using expert assessments.

articleTitle: The Actual Problems of IT-Security Process Assurance
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the aspects of IT-security of business processes, using a variety of methodological tools, including Integrated Management Systems. Currently, all IMS consist of at least 2 management systems, including the IT-Security Management System. Typically, these IMS cover biggest part of the company business processes, but in practice, there are examples of different scales, even within a single facility. However, it should be recognized that the total number of such projects both in the Russian Federation and in the World is small. The security of business processes will be considered on the example of the incident of Norsk Hydro. In the article the main conclusions are given to confirm the possibility of security, continuity and recovery of critical business processes on the example of this incident.

articleTitle: Statistic Method for Life-Cycle Processes of Digital Enterprises within Integrated Management Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the aspects of problems of decision-making by the highest leadership in the field of certification of Management Systems. These decisions may concern the number of applicable management systems and the composition of Integrated Management Systems. Such decisions are usually based on poorly formalized decisions and may have errors. In this new method, it is proposed to make decisions based on reliable and objective public information about the certification of ISO management systems. In the article, the main conclusions are given to confirm the possibility decision-making from top-manager's side based on ISO statistics trusted information.

articleTitle: The Potential of Smart Systems in Educational Mobility and Open Education
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article considers the results of Internet users' survey of different ages and different spheres of activity in order to study the awareness of SMART-systems possibilities in educational mobility. Possible sources of information are identified. Participation of respondents in different forms and projects of educational route creation is analyzed. Respondents' opinions on the functions and potential of SMART-systems for the organization of educational mobility in online learning are studied. The identified SMART-systems potential contributes to the understanding of the intellectual technologies development direction for the purpose of open education system improvement.

articleTitle: Application of the Box-Counting Method for the Evaluation of Medical Images
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The main distinctive feature of nonlinear processes in cancer is the weakening of deterministic chaos and the growth of stochastic (random) behavior at several hierarchical levels. At the border of various levels of the hierarchical organization due to the antagonism of causal relationships, there is a large area of nonlinear processes that can lead to catastrophic events - self-organization, characteristic of oncogenesis. This makes it possible to apply fractal research methods to medical images of formations on the skin.

articleTitle: Improving the Activities of Machine-Building Enterprises Through the Use of Digital Technologies
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article analyzes the improvement of machine-building enterprises through the use of digital technologies at all stages of design and production. The types of digital technologies, their advantages and disadvantages are analyzed, and the algorithm of transition to the digital method of pipe bending is proposed.

articleTitle: Module of the Automated Quality Control System of Production of Railway Wheels
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The requirements of the internal environment of the enterprise and the raising of standards of the European Union to the production of railway products has revealed areas of concern of the technological process of production of railway wheels of passenger trains. Based on the analysis of the links between the technology of manufacturing railway wheels and the quality of their functioning, the module of the automated quality control system of production is designed taking into account the elimination of possible risks. The algorithm of improvement of technological process providing production of high-quality railway wheels is developed.

articleTitle: Development of Platform for Confirming and Storing Supply Data Using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article is devoted to the development of a platform for reliable storage of information on supplies based on blockchain technology. The article discusses the main approaches to the work of decentralized applications, as well as the main problems.

articleTitle: Implementation of Electronic Document Management in Russian Education. Quality Assessment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: There are many issues in quality of education in Russia. Some of them are caused by many new rules in educational system, whereas the other part by significant differences between universities and even regions. Document automation can help to improve control of educational quality with the help of exclusion of any (or vast majority of) corruption actions, control development and quality of any students' papers assessment. Moreover, this system can help to standardize educational and assessment processes.

articleTitle: Improving RGB Registration Method for Lump Sorting of Scheelite-Bearing Ores
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The reserves of rich deposits are being rapidly worked out. Involvement in the extraction and processing of poor, hard-to-rich ores requires new approaches to the preliminary ore sorting of mineral commodities. In particular, a very common method of photometric separation needs to be developed using modern automation technologies. The most difficult problem is the adaptation of lump separation in mining technology. The new technology of formation of different - quality streams of rock mass and ore quality at the stage of mining with the use of RGB-method of registration of useful pieces in the separation of scheelite-containing ores is proposed.

articleTitle: Visualization of Human Movements Kinematics for Personalized Mobile Information-Measuring System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The report presents options for visualization of human limb models for personalized mobile information-measuring system of kinematic portrait analysis. The algorithms of the models limbs are presented. The conclusion about the necessary software to visualize the kinematics of human movements is made in the report.

articleTitle: Development of Digital Competence of Technical Specialists in the Electronic Information and Education Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Internationalization and digitalization of economy have caused future specialists to master new job functions, with digital competence becoming a critical one. The paper describes the impact of online education environment on the development of students' digital competence. Analysis of an education process in online education environment is given; features of online education environment as an educational phenomenon are identified; the principles of creating an online education environment and its characteristics are established. Professional tasks of engineering specialists and their classification into categories are presented based on professional standards analysis and expert evaluation method. Possibilities of an online education environment concerning the preparation of specialists to solve professional tasks are determined. The results of the experimental approbation of the impact of online education environment on the development of digital competence of future engineering specialists are presented.

Author Keywords: digital competence of a future specialist

articleTitle: “Online and Offline Copyrighting” Discipline in On-Line Education Format
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The experience of “Online and offline copyrighting” discipline transformation from traditional offline education format to E-Learning in Saint-Petersburg Electrotechnical university “LETI” is represented. The article provides general statistics on the course (number of students, hours of video, home works), the final indicators of the course effectiveness and assessment by students according to the survey results. There are described the features of the course development, homework checks, etc. Particular attention is paid to the comparison of fulltime classes and webinars, we highlight the pros and cons of a distance course. Special focus is made on perspectives of implementation of this distant course within the CDIO approach to engineers' education.

articleTitle: Study of the Elementary School Students' Attention Functioning on the Basis of the Brain-Computer Interface
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Special neurophysiological research with the aim of accumulating data on the patterns of attention functioning allows to develop and offer for the teachers techniques for managing students' cognitive activity. It becomes possible by real time research of brain activity in the process of solving educational tasks. Relevance of the developments is conditioned by the need in search of ways to build individualized trajectories of students taking into account objective features. Now the definition of starting positions is based on the processing of a large testing data volume. Such technologies are cumbersome, and their objectivity is often questionable. In our study we propose to use electroencephalographic data obtained through the brain-computer interface as an objective basis for the start. The article presents the psychological and pedagogical basis of the experiment on the use of brain-computer interfaces in a teacher's work. This development allows a teacher to determine the main characteristics of attention.

articleTitle: Construction of Multidimensional Stochastic Transformation Blocks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the improvement of stochastic transformation blocks (R-blocks). The principles of R- blocks construction are considered. We review the examples of R- blocks using in the cryptographic algorithms. The structure of two-dimensional stochastic transformation block is proposed, as well as the method for construction of multidimensional R- blocks. The using of improved R-blocks for construction of multidimensional algorithms is proposed. The results of evaluation of statistical properties of the multidimensional stochastic transformation blocks are given.

articleTitle: Simulation Method within Integrated Management Systems and Affects for Digital Enterprises Processes Support
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the aspects of modern simulation method for quality assurance of road construction equipment production. This new simulation method is based on well-known methodological tools, including quality management systems (QMS) and risk management standard (like as ISO 31000). Currently, all QMS for road construction equipment must have 2 mandatory phases: implementation and assessment. In accordance with new computer simulation methods, all QMS processes can be verified and updated more faster and more precise. Additional benefits of implementing the new simulation method - cost reduction and continuous improvement for QMS. In the article, the main conclusions are given to confirm the possibility performances computer simulation for conservative type of construction business processes.

articleTitle: Strategic Management Priorities of Technogenic Safety in the Electrical Industry Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article discusses the economic mechanisms in the field of technological security. Disclosed risk management concepts in the electrical industry. Presents modeling techniques at the enterprises of the electrical industry. The system of nature management at the enterprises of the electrical engineering industry is investigated; the tasks requiring the application of methods of applied statistics beyond the framework of traditional econometric tools are disclosed.

articleTitle: Development of the Face Recognition Application Using Neural Networks Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Recognition and classification are the main tasks of machine learning with a wide range of applications: determining handwritten numbers, identifying objects in video recordings, diagnostics using MRI scanning, and much more. Currently, one of the most common applications of neural network technology is face recognition in photographs or in video. For example, corporations such as Facebook are currently using neural network technologies to identify a user's friends by their faces in general photos. The paper discusses the development of face recognition applications using neural network technologies. The developed system has a relatively small size and works with a sufficiently high accuracy.

articleTitle: Conditions for Teaching Professional Competence of Future Electronics Engineers' in Digital Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article reveals the urgency of the future electronics engineers' professional competence in digital technology. The article presents its historiography and points out the scientists' points of views. The following key terms are analyzed: information, information-oriented society, professional competence, competence of digital technology, information digital competence, information technology, computer technology. The article gives the definition of professional competence in digital technology and its content and also characterizes the system of principles underlying the informational and cybernetic approaches. The most effective technologies, forms and methods of training are highlighted. Particular attention is paid to the reflexive -evaluative activities; tasks for practical and independent work, that are of applied nature. It is stressed the necessity for the development of a health culture in connection with the informatization of the educational process.

articleTitle: The Design of the Intellectual Model of the Quality Management Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The quality management is the way to the new economic and high efficient technologies. The problem of investigation is the design of the intellectual model for quality management in the automatic control systems. The object is the automatic control system used in machinery and other fields. The goal is to increase the economic efficiency and the profit. The method is modeling. The quality management model was realized on the base of the intellectual methods and the artificial neural networks. The model of the intellectual quality management was developed. The model is used for studying and training of the quality management methods.

articleTitle: Introduction of Additional Links as a Form of Purposeful Change of Dynamic States in the Tasks of the Dynamics and Automatic Control of Robotic and Technological Complexes
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article considers problems of the dynamics of the transport object, oriented to improve the reliability and safety of operation in terms of vibrational external perturbations. It proposes technologies for constructing mathematical models and determining the conditions for dynamic oscillation damping. The purpose of research is to develop a method for constructing mathematical models to estimate dynamic states and determine the conditions for obtaining dynamic effects of “zeroing out” of movements in individual coordinates. To achieve this, methods of structural mathematical modeling are used. The scientific novelty of the work involves the possibility of assessing the formation of dynamic states of mechanical oscillatory systems with the introduction of additional constraints. A technology has been developed for the transition from the transfer functions of systems to the equations of state to estimate the frequencies of dynamic oscillation damping.

articleTitle: The Experience of FSC Standard Implementation as Lead Component of Automated Systems for the Forestry Management
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This study examines the experience of using the automated Systems for Quality Control and Management (FSC) certification in the Irkutsk region. The whole process of FSC implementation was adjusted to the companies operation in forestry and reflected its main requirements. The main groups of automated systems for forest management have been identified. The wide-range FSC certification can greatly help companies to establish a timber supply chain under service control management. Tools application for products, services and management quality control is considered.

articleTitle: Digital Transformation in the Quality Management System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the problems of the quality management system's transformation in the digital economy. It is suggested an integration of quality management system in the general management system by establishing the digital platform on the enterprise. The enterprise information systems architecture are analyzed. Criteria for selection of Enterprise Resource Planning system are formed in modern conditions. Steps of implementation of the integrated system at the industrial enterprises are developed. The necessity of risk identification at all stages of the system implementation is emphasized. The authors of the article developed assessing criteria for the effectiveness of the quality management system of business processes. The expert's assessment of it was conducted at industrial enterprises.

articleTitle: Analysis of Contact Disturbance Spectra Generated in Traveling Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article formulates the problem of analysis of contact disturbance spectra in order to assess their effect on radio communication quality in traveling vehicles. Radiating circuit equivalent diagram is considered. Radiating circuit electrical parameters are evaluated using an example of truck body. Radiating circuit current modeling has been performed and its spectrum obtained.

articleTitle: Method of Non-Destructive Testing of Composite Materials
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article describes the problem of deformation research through non-destructive testing for composite materials. Describes the process of developing the installation, allowing with high accuracy to obtain the values of linear deformation of the part due to the use of a servo drive with a high-precision encoder. The installation also allows you to measure the resonant frequency of oscillation of the product. Based on the measurements, it is possible to conduct a comparative analysis of products made of composite materials. According to the test results, a method was developed for assessing the strength properties of a product made of a composite material.

articleTitle: Consulting of Choice of Information System in the Conditions of Digital Transformation of Business
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the study of ways to ensure the functional compliance of an information system (IS) with business problems in the context of its digital transformation. The main approaches to the choice of the method of acquiring an information system for the formation of the functional completeness and functional capacity of the information system are considered, the need for mutual adaptation of the information system and the business within its digitalization is determined.

Author Keywords: ways of acquiring an information system

articleTitle: Humanitarian Online Course Quality Assessment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: There are many issues in online education, especially in humanities. Humanities are based on discussion of different opinions. Therefore, online format for these courses has to provide opportunities for the discussions. Moreover, humanitarians are about independent opinion expression. Online format assumes more written tasks and ways of control, therefore questions in these tasks have to exclude opportunity to find `right' answers in the Internet.

articleTitle: Informational Support of Automated Quality Management Systems for Medical Service Provision Based on the Prognosis of the Patient Affects Outcome in Social Emergencies
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The conceptual issues of automated systems informational support for managing the quality of medical care in the long-term period are considered and informational flows concerning the features of patients affects in emergency situations of social nature are apprized. The elements of informational support indicate the medical-evacuation characteristics of the wounded, as well as the assessment of their effect on the length of stay at the stages of medical evacuation that are considered as indicators of medical service quality. Medical-statistical analysis using discriminant and survival analysis with the construction of linear discriminant functions, and function models of the withdrawal (completion of treatment) were used as supportive elements. A discriminant model has been developed including factors that influence significantly on the treatment outcome with distant prognosis of the wounded “promising to return” in the act of terrorism. A model of the length of stay in medical organizations has also been constructed.

articleTitle: Automated Quality Control Systems for Paint Coatings in Industry
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Automation of control of paint coatings in the production will significantly improve the performance of technological processes of painting and improve the quality of painting, which is necessary in the creation of competitive engineering products. Often, paint defects that occur during operation, have a negative impact on the attitude of the consumer to the product, with its overall high quality. Automation control will reduce errors in the testing of coatings, occurring due to human error and other random factors.

articleTitle: Optimizing the Construction of Gyro Sensitive Elements Based on Bulk Acoustic Waves
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The possible trends for gyro sensitive element construction optimization are discussed for the case when the bulk acoustic wave properties under rotation are the informative signal. The promising materials for creating acoustic duct and piezoelectric transducer, which make it possible to decrease sensitive element size for the same informative signal level, are considered.

articleTitle: Systems of Electronic Document Management in Russian Education. Pros and Cons
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Systems of electronic document management are wide spread in Russia. However, each university tries to use its own version or specific program for it. As a result, there are many bugs in these systems. Nevertheless, each of these systems has its own benefits for document management. Each document can simultaneously be revised by different people, it helps intensify the process of working with it. Usually the system does not allow losing any document or signature. Such systems help to improve quality management in Russian universities.

articleTitle: Anti-plagiarism System “Antiplagiat HEI”. Implementation into Russian Education Quality Improvement
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: There are many systems of quality online control, especially in the field of students' papers. The anti-plagiarism system “Antiplagiat HEI” is quite different to them due to inclusion of Russian Citation Index materials and databases. This system takes into account vast majority of Russian scientific publications. As a result, students have no possibility to use previously published works and papers. This system tends to stimulate them in preparing their papers by their own.

articleTitle: Analysis of Elastic Wave Characteristics for Solid-State Medium Propagation under Rotation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The analysis of bulk acoustic wave characteristics when propagating into rotating elastic solid-state medium is provided. Two special cases for coaxial and orthogonal relative orientation of wave propagation and medium rotation directions are considered. For these two cases the wave polarization types and phase velocities are found. The bulk acoustic wave properties that can be the base of gyro sensitive element operation are determined.

articleTitle: The Influence of the Information and Communication Technologies on the Future Electronics Engineers' Professional Mobility
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In our modern society it is impossible to become an intelligent, creative and professional mobile specialist without the information and communication technologies. We consider the professional mobility definition as an integrative quality of professional conditions on the basic components of professional culture and professional competences. The most important professional competence is the information and communication one. The uses of engineering projects are the most effective information and communication technologies for the future electronics engineers' professional mobility development. We take the projects as an example of using the problem project approach: 1) the modern electronics problems; 2) the electronics issues; 3) the knowledge of the electronics engineer.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Efficiency of Application of the Concept of CALS in Life Cycle of Products of Mechanical Engineering
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The approach to design and production of hi-tech and knowledge-intensive products consisting in use of the computer equipment and information technologies at all stages of life cycle of a product. Use of CALS technologies allows to reduce significantly the project scope as descriptions of many components of the equipment, the machines and systems projected earlier are stored in the unified formats of these network servers available to any user of CALS technologies.

articleTitle: The System of Automated Temperature Control of Biological Tissues During Electrosurgical Effects
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Currently, the vast majority of surgeries are performed using high-frequency electrosurgery or other methods based on the heating of tissues. Therefore, the following question faces a practical public health care: to what extent the tissues of the body at a distance from the place of application of energy heat up during such an operation. At the same time, to date, there is practically no information about studies of temperature fields that occur in biological organs during surgery. This paper proposes a computational-experimental simulation of the temperature field on the example of an operation to remove the gallbladder. A working computational-experimental model of the temperature field is proposed that can be used to determine the temperature in any part of the object under study. The model makes it possible to study thermal processes and control them when using an electrosurgical effect on an organ, including in robot-surgery.

articleTitle: Application of Information Systems for Optimization of Intelligent Production Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The work is devoted to the consideration of modern computer methods of multicriteria assessment of technological support of intelligent machine-building production. The application of mathematical methods in solving these problems is described. Taking into account all aspects of structural optimization, the mathematical model in the form of a graph is distinguished from the considered models, since only with the help of set theory it is possible to describe the relationship of the structural components of the technological process. The methods of linear and nonlinear programming are implemented in the multi-criteria formulation of the functional optimization problem. The analysis of existing approaches to the optimization of technological processes confirms the need to create a system of computer-methodical means of implementation of multi-level structural optimization of the production process. Now, the task of creating a system of computer-methodical means of implementation of multi-level structural optimization of advanced technological processes is relevant.

articleTitle: Electronic Informational and Educational Environment and Organization of the Educational Process of a Modern University (on the Materials of the Kabardino-Balkar State University)
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Currently, one of the significant global trends is the development of the digital economy, which has made changes in various spheres of life, namely political, socio-economic, scientific and technical spheres. This led to the need for further development of higher education. The article discusses the features of the development and design of electronic information and educational environment of the Russian University on the example of one of the universities of the North Caucasus Federal district - Kabardino-Balkar State University. The role and the level of workload that falls on the Electronic Information and educational environment in a modern educational institution that effectively carries out a multifaceted educational process are analyzed.

Author Keywords: state and professional-public regulation of educational activity

articleTitle: Computer Modelling of the Structural Materials Structure to Improve their Strength Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Nowadays, the existing level of technology development requires the fastest and the most accurate analysis methods of the studied and developed processes. The current situation in the system of computer aided design and analysis of the structural materials structure determines the need to find methods and algorithms for assessing and increasing the strength characteristics of the designed materials. The article considers the methods for computer aided research of a composite block using the foam concrete as an example with the addition of another component to improve its quality characteristics. The solution of the problem is proposed with the help of the AutoLISP programming language and the KATRAN strength analysis system.

articleTitle: «Safety and Risks Evaluation» Method for the Quality Management System for Radio-Electronic Industry Companies
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Risk and opportunity management aspects are presented. Risks classification and their characteristic are formulated. Risk assessment multi-criteria approach within the radio-electronic industry is proposed, which can be applied both within the quality management system and in integrated management systems. The safety and risk assessment method is proposed based on the developed multi-criteria approach of risk assessment and the FMEA analysis method.

Author Keywords: risk management in radio electronic industry organizations

articleTitle: Agile with relation to Conflicts Theory
