publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper presents the results of the research of interconnection between agile methodology of IT projects, system conflicts, and adaptation theory. Every project generates new unique outcomes and alters the organization. So adaptation process is unavoidable. Are conflicts unavoidable too? What is the affordable level of complexity of a project for an organization of a particular level of maturity? What is the optimal project pace? Can we tune up parameters of agile software development process such as sprint length by measuring characteristics of conflicts and stress during a project?

articleTitle: Adaptive Measuring System for On-line Monitoring of Parameters of Radio-electronic Means
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The most important component of a modern product quality control system is automated measuring devices, which exclude subjective errors during the control according to an approved method. When mass production of electronic products such tools are developed in accordance with the production technology and the life cycle of specific products. For independent quality control laboratories that carry out orders for selective control of product parameters, the use of such tools is practically excluded. In our opinion, it is advisable to equip such laboratories with automated measurement systems based on commercially produced measuring devices with the ability to quickly adapt to changing the control procedures at the program level. The paper explores the possibilities of using digital oscilloscopes of the MSO1000 series and generators of the DG1000 series as components of a measuring laboratory, analyzes the basic capabilities of these devices, and provides fragments of instrument control code for their integration into a single automated measurement system. As an example of practical implementation, the process of automated measurement of the transfer characteristic of an optical angular displacement sensor using the API functions of the Rigol MSO 1000 digital oscilloscope and the specialized transfer characteristics processing libraries is shown.

articleTitle: Improving the Quality of Higher Education with the Project Based Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the issues of ensuring the quality of the educational process using the project based learning. The features of project based learning are determined in the article. Project based learning develops professional skills that are necessary both for the students themselves and for the employers who formulate the requests. Project based learning encourages the teacher to be aware of current industry problems and ways to solve them. Participation in project based learning programs allows students to fill their portfolios and be competitive in the labor market immediately after getting higher education.

Author Keywords: innovative technologies in teaching and learning

articleTitle: Problems and Prospects of Security in the Transport Sector
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the problems of ensuring functional, informational and cyber security for vehicles and transport infrastructure facilities. The analysis of the factors causing the growth of threats to the transport sector has been carried out, the list of typical cyber attacks on the components of the transport infrastructure is given. The results of the analysis of the features of automated process control systems of technological processes of vehicles and transport infrastructure facilities are presented. Recommendations on the development of transport security systems are given taking into account the specifics of various types of transport.

articleTitle: Information-Measuring System for the Study of Motion Kinematics. Select the Frequency of Measurement Information Transmission
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The report presents the rationale for choosing the transmit frequency of measurement information of developed information- measuring system for the study of motion kinematics. Algorithmic software implementation of a measuring modules survey according to the requirements on the transmit frequency is described. The results of the program are presented.

Author Keywords: the work schedule of the IMS

articleTitle: Research of the Gibbs Phenomenon under Periodic Signals with Discontinuities of the First Kind on Basis of the LabViewComplex
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The development of laboratory practical work in the electrical engineering course is due to the use of the control-measuring LabVIEW complex that combines technical means of measurement and control, software and standard computer technologies. An essential advantage of the LabViewis the ability to control the measurement process in automatic or interactive mode. The contemporary technology of the virtual measuring devices, which are a part of the LabVIEW complex, enables to operate with the means of supervision, measurement and control, to treat the results of researches. The advantages of the LabViewcomplex are illustrated with the example of the Gibbs phenomenon investigation under periodic signals with discontinuities of the first kind described by the truncated Fourier series. The methods of smoothing of the truncated Fourier series and improvement of convergence are represented. A discussed question is important in electrical engineering, radio engineering, microelectronics, biomedicine, etc.

articleTitle: Mathematical Support of Modeling Methods in Quality Management Problems of Complex System and Processes
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the problem of mathematical support of situational approach to the development of management decision support systems in the management of the quality of complex objects. Based on the analysis of the main tasks that are solved when making management decisions, the sequence of procedures necessary for their solution is determined. The methods of modeling, allowing to carry out a comprehensive assessment of the state of the object in the presence of both quantitative and qualitative assessment indicators, are proposed. This determines the relevance and novelty of the proposed approach. This determines the relevance and novelty of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Problems of Learning Programming in Introductory Course
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In the Russian Federation, computer science is part of the subject area “Mathematics and Computer science”. This often leads to a focus on the “technological” component of the course for various reasons. However, even analyzing the FSES of PE, we can conclude that the basis of algorithmic thinking should be laid even at such a young age. The article will consider the history of the school environments and programming languages development in the USSR, Russia, Europe and other countries, current trends in teaching computer science in the propaedeutic course and the existing problems in teaching this subject in school. There is a certain practice of using Logo, Pervologo, KuMir, Algorithmika - all of them allow to implement education taking into account the age characteristics of students. We will pay attention to the PencilCode and Scratch block and text programming environments, as well as to the modern Squeak and Alice environments.

articleTitle: Algorithmic Support of Information-Measuring System to Assess the Mutual Impact of the Railway Track And the Adjacent Territory
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The algorithmic support of the information-measuring system is developed to assess the mutual influence of the railway and the surrounding area. The description of the monitoring system of the adjacent territory and the railway track is presented. The algorithms for estimating the intensity factor of influence are shown.

articleTitle: The Cybernetic Approach as the Digital Competence of the Future Electronics Engineers
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the cybernetic approach. It is a digital competence factor of the future electronics engineers. The digital competence is an integral part of the professional competence. In the article it is underlined the wealth of information and the need to form the students' information culture. It is described the content of cybernetic pedagogy. There are examples of some scientists. In the article it is stressed the need to use the cybernetic approach in our society. The cybernetics methods and principles are described.

articleTitle: Context-Dependent Synonym and Concept Extraction for Dialogue Systems Training
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Modern scenario-based approaches to the construction of dialogue systems require extraction of domain-dependent synonyms and concepts. For example, making rules for rule-based dialogue systems is greatly facilitated by the ability to automatically generate synonyms for keywords. Automatic detection of domain concepts allows to make a list of slots that need to be filled to create service scenarios in goal-oriented dialogues. This paper describes the method of unsupervised synonym and concept extraction from natural language texts. Our method includes context-dependent algorithms (based on applying word embeddings) and does not require using tagged data and external resources.

articleTitle: Key Issues of Humanitarian Online Education
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: There are many issues in online education, especially in humanities. Humanities are based on discussion of different opinions. Therefore, online format for these courses has to provide opportunities for the discussions. Moreover, humanitarians are about independent opinion expression. Online format assumes more written tasks and ways of control, therefore questions in these tasks have to exclude opportunity to find `right' answers in the Internet.

articleTitle: Open Education. Russian MOOC Platform. Prospects of Development
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Open Education is Russian MOOC platforms. Just several countries have their own MOOC platforms. Russia is one of them. Currently, many of the best courses of this platform are doubled in Coursera. However, many other courses are published just in this platform and how no counterparts in the top world platforms. The MOOC platform has many prospects of development in Russia and other CIS counties due to famous lecturers from the best universities of Russia.

articleTitle: Role Model Features in Educational Serious Games
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The problem of group interaction in game tasks is considered. Due to the fact that modern learning tools based on gamification are often distributed, user-oriented and practically lacking in security subsystems, the logical debugging of group interaction models is information security. Based on information security training as an example, the main features of the interaction model role formation are chosen, such models' peculiarities for various types of game tasks are specified. The issues of assigning and minimizing privileges, phishing and prohibited variants of the interaction of roles counteraction, changing the role and privileges during the game are considered. The limitation of game information flows to prohibit or control the transmitted confidential information is considered separately. The experimental model shows the limitations and features approach, which solves group interaction problems using the role model. The results obtained allow improving the group interaction security by filtering and limiting information flows. Solutions implementation described in the article is possible when developing game cases, quests or other educational game tasks.

articleTitle: Directions of Strategic Development of the Information Society in Modern Russia
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article presents a study of the structure and content of the “Digital Economy of the Russian Federation” program, as well as approaches for its implementation in order to ensure the systematic development and implementation of digital technologies in all areas of life in modern Russia. In addition, forms of strategic development that are relevant to the new information society are presented with a detailed justification of the consequences in the information application of each.

articleTitle: Problems of Development of Information Technology to Assess the Quality of Mobile Learning Results
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article considers information technologies development problems to assess the effectiveness of mobile learning. A survey of Internet users was conducted to identify the level of awareness of this aspect, which led to the conclusion that the problem of developing systems for assessing the quality of mobile learning is relevant and necessary. These technologies will contribute to the development of open education, the expansion of its functions, as well as the self-organization of students to select mobile learning trajectory.

Author Keywords: information technologies for evaluation of mobile learning quality

articleTitle: The Use of Information and Communication Technologies in Teaching Foreign Languages to Students of Technical Specialties in Accordance with Their Dominant System of Information Perception
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In the following article the issues of methodically justified use of ICT in the process of teaching foreign languages are discussed, the types of ICT, satisfying the requirements of the dominant model of information perception, are identified, the principles of selection and presentation of materials for a more effective educational process are revealed, the results of experimental work on the introduction of elements of flipped class technology and programming learning are presented.

articleTitle: Computer Games to Fill the Gap in Learning Functional Lexis at Russian Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This paper sets up the problematic issues of teaching professionally oriented English vocabulary to college and university students and suggests using a number of thematic computer games as a solution. The author claims that fascinating activities of playing language computer games expand the students' perspectives, fill the gap in vocabulary, motivate to learn English, develop students' abilities to internet search, quick reading in English, and digital competence in general.

articleTitle: Surgical Instrument Supply Automated System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article describes the problem of supplying instruments to a surgeon during an operation. A method of automating the process is proposed by creating a robotic system that is able to carry out the transfer of the necessary tools to the workspace at the right time of the operation. An analysis of the task of automating the process of supplying tools was carried out, alternative manual techniques were considered. The problems arising in the development of a robotic system are described, methods of solution are proposed. On the basis of the proposed methods, a general approach to solving the problem has been developed.

articleTitle: Detection and Localization of Emergency Situations in the Process of Robotic Surgery Based on the Video Image Analysis System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article describes the problem of detecting and localizing abnormal situations in the process of robot-surgical operations based on a video analysis system. A method for automated inspection of the operated cavity due to digital image processing in real time is proposed. The digital detection and localization system exceed the capabilities of a person in terms of the duration of work and the repeatability of the result, which reduces the likelihood of false alarms or missing events. The analysis of the problem was carried out, the methods of solution were selected. Based on the selected methods, a block diagram of the system has been developed for its further implementation.

articleTitle: The Investigation of Surface Quality of Metal Details Obtained with Modern Shaping Methods in Engineering
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article is focused on the feasibility of using of processing based on the action of cathode-anodic processes in order to improve quality of the surface for details produced with laser melting of different powders (predominantly aluminum and steel). The action influence of the combined process can provide the quality which required by machining. The comprehensive surface machining is achieving by the common actions of the cutter, milling cutter or abrasive and the metal dissolution that caused the action of an electricity and chemical processes. The way of processing like that has possibilities for obtaining the high-quality surface unlike conventional cutting processes. The using of anodic-mechanical action on the surface that has been obtained by selective laser melting will allow to reach the necessary roughness and waviness level practically for all types of the parts formed of metal.

articleTitle: Development of Unified Morphological Models for the Research of Different Physical Processes in Electronic Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper proposes morphological models for the analysis of complex electronic systems quality criterion. The reason for resorting to morphological models is the need to increase attention to improving the quality and reliability of electronic systems in the early design stages. At the same time, many difficulties of mathematical modeling of the investigated heterogeneous physical processes occurring in electronic systems are solved. In this paper, the unification of the notation and the image of components based on analogies of mathematical descriptions. In linear synthesis morphological models in the form of connection of multipolar systems are offered. But they allow you to explore the electrical, mechanical and thermal processes only in linear approximation. In contrast to this representation, the paper also proposes unified view of morphological models in the form of a hypergraph, which will cover nonlinear cases.

articleTitle: Algorithmization of Internal Quality Management Systems of Educational Organizations on the Base of International Standards
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article describes the algorithm for creating and improving the internal quality management systems of educational organizations. This algorithm is based on using the international standards and integrated approach in accordance with the requirements of ISO 9001 and ISO 21001 standards as well as the principles of CHIBA, ESG ENQA and GGP standards. Quality management and quality analysis tools and methods are proposed in this algorithm such as Quality Function Deployment and SWOT analysis.

articleTitle: Laser Instrument Correction System for Robotic Surgery
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The problem described in this paper is the need to ensure the required power of the laser tool in a particular place in space to ensure high accuracy and minimally invasiveness. The use of a robotic-assisted complex allows the development of an automatic control system that, having data on the parameters of the laser used, data on the type of tissue being treated, the surgeon's intentions and the stereo video sequence, will correct the distance from the optical fiber boundary to the patient's tissue, minimizing the size of the laser spot. The analysis of the problem was carried out, the methods of solution were selected. Based on the selected methods, a block diagram of the system has been developed for its further implementation.

articleTitle: Use of a Convolutional Neural Network to Improve the Quality of the Surgeon's Work in Robotic-assisted Surgery
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Robotic technologies are rapidly entering various spheres of human activity. The most innovative direction in medicine is a robot-assisted technique for performing surgical interventions. This article describes the computer decision support system as an additional tool in such a complex.

articleTitle: Filtering Content Distributed via BitTorrent over Hidden Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article addresses the problem of distributing copyrighted thematic content to increase the possibilities for restricting access to such content. The analysis of existing solutions in this area is carried out, highlighting the shortcomings of these solutions, options for applying these methods to limit the distribution of thematic content in hidden parts of the Internet. A new approach is proposed to limit access to thematic content that is distributed using the BitTorrent protocol in hidden networks. The proposed approach also uses the disadvantages and advantages of the network in which thematic content is distributed. An experiment is described for applying this approach to Darknet resources. The results of the experiment highlighted the pros and cons of the proposed approach. The final part contains conclusions about the possibility of using the proposed approach in hidden networks.

articleTitle: New Scientific and Educational Technologies in Transport Industry
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Step-by-step digitalization of production and economic activities, physical assets, opportunities and prospects of innovative development of the transport industry as part of the Digital Electronic Communication System (DECS ecosystem).

Author Keywords: development of Digital Electronic Communication System (DECS)
the criteria monitoring and rational alternatives choice matrix

articleTitle: Development of a Decision Support System for Intellectual Property Utilization
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This paper outlines the concept of intellectual property utilization and develops a framework for the targeted generation of intellectual property for the benefit of various economic entities. The study proposes two types of the decision support system: (i) based on deterministic logic, and (ii) based on multi-agent systems. The results of the study offer the development of a mathematical approach to the interaction process of agents in multi-agent systems, inter alia related to the targeted generation of intellectual property.

articleTitle: Metod of Foresight Modeling in Electronic Space Projects
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In the projects of space electronics, because of its constant complication, the existing methods of the Foresight involving qualified specialist designers of electronic equipment as experts, no longer provide guaranteed solutions for ensuring important reliability indicators. In this paper, the authors propose to select computer programs and carry out comprehensive modeling to increase the efficiency of the expert panels at the stage of technical design of space electronic equipment. Thus, experts receive complete information about the physical processes in future electronic equipment. Considering this information, they make decisions on the use of these or other advanced technologies, and can also more reasonably express their proposals on synthesized approaches to creating electronic equipment for long periods of its use in space. This method should be referred to as the Foresight Modeling method. This paper describes the basics of the theory of this method and gives an example of an algorithm for the Foresight Modeling of thermal processes in the design of an electronic power supply system. Taking into account the resource of this system, experts can more accurately judge the long-term existence of new-generation spacecraft.

articleTitle: Optical Angular Displacement Sensors
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the research and development of a contactless optical sensor for instrumental means of product quality control. The paper presents results of the study of sensitivity of incoherent optical OTDR type sensors to the angular displacement of the reflecting surface. The results of experimental studies of the transfer characteristics of the sensor with transceiver modules of various configurations are presented. Variants of the structure of the measuring channel of the sensor to obtain the maximum range of measured angles are offered. The influence of non-informative parameters on the measurement results is analyzed. The results of mathematical modeling of the angular displacement sensor based on the laws of geometric optics are presented.

articleTitle: An Approach to the Establishment of an Automated Energy Efficiency Improvement System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper is dedicated to an approach to the enterprise's energy efficiency management based on the synthesis of energy management methods and mathematical modeling of technological and engineering features of the object as well as processes of its functioning.

articleTitle: Risk Management Automation in Energy Company Projects
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The specific character of energy company's projects based on the principles of project investment is presented. The process of creating a risk management system as part of company's projects is described. Justification of efficiency of the chosen model and automation of the risk analysis process at each workplace is given.

articleTitle: Key Methods of Electronic Tools Quality Assurance Review
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Thereare many methods of electronic tools quality assurance. In the paper key methods are presented and discussed. The paper concentrates on pros and cons of different methods. Statistical methods are at the focus of the research. The aim of the article is to study an issue of statistical method implementation and its limits for quality assurance of electronic tools.

articleTitle: Information Technologies in Science in Solving Some Environmental Problems of Natural Landscapes Based on the Synthesis of Accumulated Empirical Experience
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The developed method of constructing generalized models of management and environmental forecasting processes on complex modified techno-natural systems is proposed. The construction of generalized models is based on accumulated empirical experience of well-known science schools and prominent scientists using the capabilities of modern computer technology. As a rule, leading scientists' accumulated experience is generalized, and it is presented as empirical formulas. The construction of generalized models is performed on the basis of computational experiment using mathematical theory of experiment planning. The objects of the research are the subsystems of natural landscapes as a complex modified geosystem, they are: slope subsystem; ravine and gully subsystem; river subsystem and water management complex. Conceptual models and algorithms of construction and solution of the scientific problem of complex techno-natural systems' management such as the mountain and foothill landscape are presented in the report developed by Russian scientific schools.

articleTitle: Methods of Automating Processes in Statistical Control and Quality Management Field
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Main aspects of statistical control of quality management processes of both products and existing processes in the enterprise are discussed. Based on the criteria selected for comparison, a comparative analysis of the existing software for statistical management is carried out. The advantages and disadvantages of systems are noted and the answer to the question of the applicability of each of the systems in the problem of process automation is formed. The main perspective directions of modernization of the existing systems and development of new systems on statistical management of processes are allocated.

articleTitle: Hands-On Games for Motivating Students' Math Training
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper dwells on hands-on computer games to promote students' motivation when studying mathematics. The authors emphasize the necessity of consistent actualizing of practice covering university math study. The revision is possible if students become involved in learning mathematics as active participants but not who are just imparted math skills. The required technique contains three components, which include solving applied problems, using information technologies and a kind of students' exercises innovation. The authors describe a computer game in teaching Optimization Techniques as an example used for engineering students. Solving true-to-life problems, modern information technologies and young people's passion for gadgets allows increasing their contribution to learning activities. The research proved the efficiency of such games in teaching mathematics. In particular, qualitative academic progress in the experimental group has increased by 11%. Using hands-on computer games lets the lecturers' present mathematics as a universal language to study natural and social phenomena.

articleTitle: Current Trends in Using Information and Communication Technologies at Universities
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In this paper the authors have examined some current trends in using information and communication technologies at universities. They have justified the need to improve existing approaches to university management software products. University management is featured by intensive use of rapidly-growing information and communication technologies, especially, in conditions of economy digitalization. Introduction of the software products tested on management models of business structures is considered as the priority area for information and communication technologies at universities. The paper gives a detailed analysis of the software products introduced to university management system. The authors point out some priority tasks for implementation of the software products. Special attention is drawn to classification of software management products according to the level of the tasks. Three levels of task solution are singled out. These levels are: solving typical tasks, automation of more complex management decisions and partial solution of business process control automation. The possibility of introducing configurations of the management software product which is known as "1C: Management by Objectives and KPIs" is considered. It aims at keeping control over research and scientific work, contract-based research and the work of research laboratories at universities. Some trends of establishing a new university corporate culture based on the principles of combining commercial (quantitative) and humanitarian approaches to assess the efficiency of university management systems are substantiated. It is emphasized that quantitative approaches are based on the balanced system of indicators and the system of key performance indicators to assess efficiency of individual projects implementation. The system of quality indicators covers the level of university's performance regarding training and professional development of the staff that meet requirements of the professional standards and are aware of their social mission.

articleTitle: Issues of Replacement Blocks Quality Assessment for Stochastic Information Security
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the issues of building and quality assessment of replacement block or S-box, which is one of the main blocks of cryptographic transformation. The principles of S-box designing are considered, examples of their using in modern block ciphers are given. The issues of assessing the statistical safety of S-boxes, in particular, the criteria used for the analysis of S-blocks are investigated. The structure of the program system for the study of the statistical properties of S-boxes is proposed. The results of the S-boxes analysis for the main modern cryptographic algorithms are given. Assumptions about the possibility of mathematical apparatus using for the statistical properties of S-boxes analyzing are made.

articleTitle: Educational Quality Control through Online Checks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Online checks are widespread in modern educational technologies. In vocational training of civil servants, this kind of control is commonly used. In other educational activities it is not so widespread in Russia. The most popular tool is the antiplagiat.ru platform used for testing students' papers quality. Undoubtedly, online checks of educational quality should not be restricted by the use of this program. The paper describes the possibilities of educational quality control development with the help of online technologies.

articleTitle: Quality Assurance of Quality Management Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The quality management system (QMS) is considered as a complex automated system, which is an integral part of the control system of a complex automated complex. The effectiveness of the automated quality management system (AQMS) is determined by its quality, which is formed in the design process of both the AQMS itself and the quality management object. AQMS, as well as the object of quality management, is considered as a set of different kinds of information (software, methods, algorithms, etc.) related to each other and jointly processed at all stages of the life cycle of the control object. A special role in shaping the quality of the AQMS is played by the early design stages, which determine the goals of creating the control object and the basic requirements for its quality.

articleTitle: An Autosteering Gear System with a Fuzzy Regulator Adjusted by a Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This paper gives a quick overview of current positioning vessel seaway systems with particular focus on autosteering gear systems involving elements of artificial intelligence systems. The authors recommend an autosteering system containing a fuzzy logic regulator to obtain control activity; a neural network classifier enabling to select optimal neural network models of the vessel paths; and an optimizer with a genetic algorithm that promotes controller parameter settings on a fuzzy logic. The paper submits findings from obtaining optimal neural network architectures, which are prospective for composing neural network models of the sea vessel paths. The conducted simulation modeling for a trawler, one of the most difficult sea craft to control, allows the researchers to make positive conclusions on the introduced system operation.

articleTitle: An Integrated Approach to Ensure Electromagnetic Compatibility in the Design of Electronic Devices
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article discusses an integrated approach to the design of EM, taking into account the provision of electromagnetic compatibility parameters. The article considers the original approach with the help of which the study of general integrated noise immunity is carried out because of the criteria providing noise immunity and noise immunity. The stated principles of the design approach allow us to solve the problem of applying optimal circuitry and design solutions in the design of noise-resistant and noise-resistant EM.

articleTitle: Importance of Modern Educational Technologies in Russian Districts
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Modern educational online technologies are the most important in distinct districts of Russia. Thus, in Moscow, Saint-Petersburg, Perm, Novosibirsk, Ekaterinburg and other large cities there are many educational opportunities in higher and secondary education. Whereas in small cities and towns there is lack of opportunities. Therefore scholars and students from these areas have no possibilities to get proper education without online technologies. The paper is based on statistical data about education in Russia. The result of the research is that online education cannot just explore ordinary education in distinct regions, but also can substitute it.

articleTitle: Information Technologies in the Solution of Some Environmental Problems on Mountain and Foothill Landscapes
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Mountain and foothill landscapes are complex techno and natural systems consisting of subsystems, each of which is defeated of destructive influence of water runoff. One of the most effective ways to solve this problem is computer simulation of processes using the mathematical planning theory based on a computational experiment. A methodology of model development is proposed, as well as an integral indicator that takes into account such factors as: reliability, efficiency and environmental friendliness.

articleTitle: Algorithm of Ensuring Accuracy Indicators of Radioelectronic Devices with Consideration of Thermal Modes
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In this paper the authors describe an algorithm for ensuring the accuracy of radio electronic devices operating in conditions of extended ambient temperature ranges. A mathematical apparatus for taking into account the coefficients of heat loads on electronic components is presented when analyzing their technological deviations. The purpose of this work is to create an algorithm for calculating the limiting value of the coefficient of heat load, which will provide the specified value of the indicator of the accuracy of radio electronic device in the form of a deviation for the output characteristic. The peculiarity of solving the problem of accuracy in this work is to consider the problems of analyzing the technological deviations on the parameters of electronic components, taking into account the deviations not only on the output electrical characteristics, but also on the temperature of the cases of electronic components.

articleTitle: Improving the Accuracy of Thunderstorm Clouds Detection in Mechatronic Systems for Remote Monitoring of Natural Hazards
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: At the heart of mechatronic systems for remote monitoring of natural hazards such as thunderstorms and hail clouds are radar research methods. A radar model of hail clouds is developed, taking into account the influence of the charge of individual hydrometeors on their scattering properties. Calculations have shown that within the framework of the considered radar model of a hail cloud, there is a noticeable increase in radar reflectance compared to a neutral cloud. At certain ratios between the average cubic diameter of the hail particles, the surface charge density and the wavelength, large bursts of radar reflectance occur. Such resonance phenomena are more pronounced in media with low absorption, which include ice.

articleTitle: Development of Tasks on Computer Science According to the Concept of Developmental Learning of L.V. Zankov
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the teaching of computer science to elementary school students in accordance with the concept of developmental learning of L.V. Zankov. It was created in the 60's of the XX century, when the course of computer science was absent in school. Currently, there is no computer science textbook developed by the team continuing the idea of L.V. Zankov. For this reason, teachers have to either refuse to teach this subject or choose their own textbooks and manuals. The article presents the basic didactic principles on which the system of developing education is based. On the basis of these principles, as well as the analysis of existing computer science textbooks for elementary school, the developed tasks on various computer science topics in the context of the developing education system are presented.

Author Keywords: development of tasks in computer scienceformatting

articleTitle: Improving the Process of Bending Pipes with Digital Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the results of improving the technological process through the introduction of CALS-technology, digital technology and information security requirements. The improvement of the process of pipe bending takes place in reducing the time of the process, reducing the proportion of defective products and processing of products.

articleTitle: Actual Problems of Product Serviceability Assessment Based on the Analysis of Research Results Obtained Through X-Ray Computed Tomography Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Currently, non-destructive testing methods, X-ray computed tomography method in particular, are widely used to diagnose critical products in all major industries (nuclear industry, metallurgy, mechanical engineering, energy, aerospace, oil and gas). An important step in assessing the quality of a product material is the X-ray tomographic scanning results analysis by an operator via specialized software. This paper presents an overview of existing solutions for the tomographic research results analyzing, identifies the main drawbacks and problems of modern methods of various products serviceability assessment.

articleTitle: Control of UAV Based on Biological Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This paper considers a development of a light source search model for the unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) program control. The UAV is a quadcopter. The search model based on the Lotka- Volterra equations contains the trend to rotate to the left and trend to rotate to the right. Depending on the interaction of trends, the VAV rotates in one direction or another. The purpose of the search is a light source. The biological control algorithm is adapted for the quadcopter. The robot's algorithms have been developed for searching and tracking modes. The contribution of this paper is to propose the algorithm of actions in cases of search and loss of visual contact with the source. We provide the simulation of values change dynamics of quadcopter rotations trends. The simulation results demonstrate a high degree of entropy, which allows the quadcopter to explore a large area. The trajectory of the robot is constantly changing and depends on the location of other similar sources.

articleTitle: Quality Management in Industrial Design. Modern Tendencies
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Designis a difficultly measurable object, especially in terms of quality. Industrial design is a kind of design that operates with manufacturing objects. Undoubtedly, they are more measurable than some arts objects due to implementation of design to production needs. Therefore, quality of industrial design is measured and managed with the help of quantity criterion. The paper presents review of modern tendencies in this field, applicable to quality management.

articleTitle: Development of Software Architecture for Automated Systems of Tunnel Construction Based on Jet Grouting Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The method of software development for automated control of tunnel construction in complicated geological conditions with application of Jet Grouting technology is considered in this paper. The software that implements the engineering calculations is based on the developed Jet Grouting process control system architecture. The software is equipped with the module of spatial visualization and quality control of strengthened tunnels shaping.

articleTitle: Multi-criteria Study of Navigation Systems and Software for the Construction of Information and Navigation System of the Historical Building
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The purpose of this work was the study of modern navigation systems in relation to historical buildings that have distinctive features. Among which we can highlight the complex layout and difficulties with the organization of radio signal propagation. In this paper, modern navigation systems were investigated with the aim of their applicability for building a route in the context of historical buildings. It has been suggested that these systems can be applied in such difficult conditions to organize educational and tourist routes. Experimental studies of common user location systems were carried out and a multicriteria comparison was carried out using the hierarchy analysis method, with the result that the method based on the Bluetooth beacons of Bluetooth low energy was chosen as optimal for a historic building. Also, this method was applied to the study of software for building an information and navigation system and was chosen INDOORS.

articleTitle: Copywriting in Online Education
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the study of the phenomenon of online courses in the field of mass communication, in particular educational technologies on copywriting. The authors analyze the specifics of technologies that are used to teach the art of copywriting on various electronic resources. In addition, the article discusses the tools for creating effective text to attract the target audience to the company's website and inform about a product or service hosted in the Internet space, discusse techniques for creating SED-texts.

articleTitle: Topic Modeling of Scientific Publications in the Specialty of “Dentistry”
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The intellectual analysis of texts and the task of identifying the thematic structure of documents allows us to solve various applied problems associated with documental retrieval, automatic selection of keywords and annotation of documents. In the parsing task of the dynamics of topics in a large number of scientific works, the automatic determination of text details of a work or article becomes fundamentally important. The use of machine learning methods and thematic modeling allows us to solve such problems. This paper analyzes the multiple data of the Russian Science Citation Index (dynamics of topics and keywords (phrases)) in the scientific specialty of Dentistry based on the analysis of more than 15,000 Russian texts of scientific articles published from 2005 to 2015. Thematic modeling of the corpus of available documents has been carried out on the base of the papers titles analysis. Using the methods of extracting keywords in the document and identifying the main topics in the corpus of documents, the dynamics and distribution of the top keywords and phrases, as well as the change of thematic focus of articles in the analyzed period have been analyzed.

articleTitle: UWB Signal Receiver Input Cancellation Efficiency in Ranging System with Onboard Speed Sensor
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Blanking and cancellation are successfully used to block the powerful interferences in many applications, but in the area of UWB navigation it is difficult to retrieve efficiency of interference cancellation. This research is devoted to the evaluation of cancellation efficiency in conditions of pulse interferences environment in an underground mine with cargos, equipped with autonomous onboard speed sensors. Using the experimentally obtained interference environment model the matched filter receiver is modelled during computer simulation. The signal-to-noise ratio on the matched filter output is increased on 1.9 dB due to the interference cancellation, making the cancellation efficiently applicable in underground mine UWB navigation.

articleTitle: To the Prospects of the Formation of a New Paradigm of Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article shows that the ingrained orientation of engineering education to the demands of the labor market requires rethinking and adjustment, since in modern conditions it does not guarantee the ability of an engineer to meet the challenges of the future. A real guarantee of the success of engineering education is now taking into account, along with the order of the labor market, also historical and epistemological trends in the development of knowledge, its functions and forms of existence. In this context, techno-science and the principle of “oriented intellect” are of particular relevance in the training of an engineer. It is also emphasized that the current trends in the development of knowledge bring to life a new paradigm of education - projective-personal.

Author Keywords: trends in the development of knowledge
oriented intellect as the principle of training an engineer

articleTitle: Automatic Blood Glucometer-Tonometer to Control Diabetes Mellitus
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The control of diabetes mellitus is an actual problem of modern medicine and should be accompanied by the monitoring of the glycemic level in a continuous mode. We have proposed a non-invasive computational method for the study of glycemia, based on modeling the correlation relationship of hemodynamic and biochemical blood parameters. Mathematical empirical formulas for calculating blood glucose levels by blood pressure indicators during the day, which allow us to create a database for monitoring indicators, were obtained. A new automatic analyzer has been developed. It measures blood pressure and non-invasively calculates blood glucose using an application program using empirical formulas. The analyzer's control microcontroller, mounted on the base of the ATmega85 8-bit programmable microcontroller, contains an application program for the UART universal asynchronous transceiver - an interface that allows us to connect the device to the computer using a 6-pin USB-UART converter. Using application programs and signaling devices, the device allows blood pressure measurement, non-invasive calculation of blood glucose levels and real-time transfer of the database to a computer with the ability to analyze the results. The device can be used in medical institutions in the diagnosis of arterial hypertension and diabetes mellitus, as well as for self-control.

articleTitle: The Neural Network Simulation of Instance-Aware Semantic Image Segmentation System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This paper presents the system of the recognition and segmentation of objects which is based on an effective method for semi-controlled instance-aware segmentation of video and images. The system allows to achieve high quality forecasting of segmentation annotations for video frames while processing in real time. For this purpose a neural network model was proposed in the form of a Siamese deep network with a structure “encoder-decoder” which is designed to take advantage of both propagation-based and detection-based methods while avoiding the weaknesses of both approaches. The network was trained in a two-stage training process that uses both synthetic and real data and works reliably without online training or post-processing. The quality of the trained model was tested on training video.

articleTitle: Online Education in Russia. Modern Trends and Tendencies
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Online education is extremely important in Russia due to country geography. There are many students in distinct areas. Online education for them usually is the only opportunity for getting high quality education in their region. During the last several years due to Internet coverage development online education has become more wide spread. Modern trends and tendencies in this field are development of humanitarian and social courses, search of opportunities to provide group discussions in this format, foundation of many online schools and universities. The main problem in this area is low government regulation and as a result low quality of education.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Results of E-Learning practice in Russia and Prospects for Its Development
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper presents the analysis of e-learning technologies adoption in the higher education environment in Russia and advanced countries. Online study grows rapidly in the modern world. This area of higher education in Russia does not currently exceed the global growth rate but is developing rapidly, especially in external programs and advanced training.

articleTitle: The Development of a Reference Architectural Prototype of the Internet of Things Network Mode
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the research and development of the reference architectural of the Internet of Things model (hereinafter IoT) with a description of the main components that will allow the integration of heterogeneous IoT technologies into a single interconnected architecture. A prototype layout was developed to demonstrate the state of the environmental conditions, monitor and control actuators. The IoT object has the ability to dynamically change its topology and /or operating parameters in accordance with the requirements of a particular user, when it is necessary within the framework of the current service policy, optimization of network bandwidth or other indicators. Therefore, in practice, the cognitive things on the Internet will be able to dynamically and autonomously adjust their working parameters and protocols in accordance with the knowledge gained to achieve predetermined goals, in particular, to select the most appropriate radio transmission technology.

articleTitle: Electronic Educational Environment as an Innovative Tool for Growth of Competitiveness and Economic Depolarization of Municipalities (Based on the Materials of the Kabardino-Balkarian Republic)
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Innovative development of the economy updates the issues of smoothing social and economic polarization in the development of municipal formations of subsidized regions. One vector of solutions to this problem is the preparation of innovative and active personality through continuing education. In these conditions, a special question is the design and implementation of the electronic educational environment that allows for the preparation of “innovative personality”, which is characterized by a developed motivation for innovative activity, high potential for self-realization, readiness to change existing behavioral stereotypes, tolerance to uncertainty and other qualities. This is what makes it necessary to consider in detail the innovative tools of competitiveness growth and economic depolarization of municipalities. The main purpose of the work is to study the relationship between the impact of the educational environment, the level of human potential and the smoothing of polarization on the example of one of the regions in the North Caucasus Federal District - the Kabardino-Balkarian Republic. This targeted research has led to the formulation and solution of the following tasks: to assess the state of the electronic educational environment of universities in the aspect of continuous education and training of innovative and active personality, to explore the possibility of obtaining IT education, to assess the state of the economy of municipal entities of the Kabardino-Balkarian Republic in the aspect of socio-economic polarization.

articleTitle: Methods for Identification of Analytical Models of Noise with Symmetric Distribution Laws
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article concerns the methods of approximate identification for the form of the curve for noise probability density function (PDF) affecting the information signal. It is shown that even for relatively small amounts of sampling, numerical estimations of the form noise PDF are determined with an accuracy of 5-10%.

articleTitle: Development of a Combined Mechatronic System Based on a Mobile Platform and a Drone for Monitoring of Natural Hazards in Mountainous Areas
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The development of mountain areas is complicated by a number of natural hazards, which primarily include mudflows and snow avalanches. The article presents the results of the development of a combined mechatronic system based on a mobile platform and a drone for monitoring natural hazards in mountainous areas. The mobile platform delivers the drone to the area of a mudflow or avalanche area, where it is difficult and dangerous to approach. From the mobile platform, a drone equipped with a video camera is launched, which monitors a territory according to a given program. The mobile platform is equipped with a power source for automatic recharging of drone batteries.

articleTitle: Research on the Development of Elementary School Students' Attention in Computer Science Lessons
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Research related to the methodology of computer science course studying in elementary school is underway in Russia for more than thirty years. Based on the literature analysis, it can be concluded the main focus of such research is on the development of course content, the choice of educational technologies and teaching methods, as well as the development of age-appropriate digital educational resources. In our opinion, there are very few works which are devoted to the problem of the certain psychological processes formation, including attention. The article is devoted to the development of elementary school-age students' attention in the process of teaching computer science. Contains a brief overview of the concept definition problem of “attention” in the domestic psychological and pedagogical science. There are recommendations for teachers on the lesson organization, contributing to create of educational situations for the attention development. The analysis of the tasks contained in various educational and methodical complexes in computer science for the focus presence in them on the development of this cognitive process.

articleTitle: Modeling the Effectiveness of Solutions for Technogenic Safety in the Electrical Industry
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article reviews the problem of providing software for systematic approach to the development of management decision support systems for managing and forecasting the development of complex objects. The sequence of the main stages of management decision-making in a systematic approach is provided. Based on the analysis of this sequence, the features of the formal description of controllable objects of various nature are highlighted. The peculiarity of the suggested approach is the combination of a systematic approach to decision-making, heuristic methods and based on the theory of conflict situations. Using game-theoretic modeling, a method of evaluating the probability of technological accidents and industrial disasters, taking into account the size of alleged damage has been developed. The directions of diagnostics and monitoring the management of engineering systems quality, production processes and the personnel of electrical enterprises have been outlined.

articleTitle: Forecasting Changes in States in Social Networks and Sentiment Security Using the Principles of Percolation Theory and Stochastic Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel method of forecasting changes in social network systems based on applying percolation theory and a stochastic dynamics approach. New results from computer modeling the influence of a social network density on its percolation threshold are discussed. Percolation thresholds are calculated for various network densities and can be used in models describing the stochastic dynamics of a system's transition from one state to another. For example, with the help of the developed models, it is possible to forecast the change in time of the share of people with certain opinions and views depending on the network density, percolation threshold, etc. The stochastic model represented in this paper presents the possibility of a jump-like transition of moods (states) of people in a social network during a very short period of time without any external influences, which is defined by the system's self-organisation features and the memory of its nodes about the previous states.

Author Keywords: monitoring and management of a social network

articleTitle: Intelligent Transport Systems as an Integration Platform for Creating a Network of Regional Transport and Logistics Complexes
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article presents the study results of the regions readiness to the formation of intelligent transport systems as the basis for creating a network of transport and logistics clusters. The statistical comparative analysis of the regions potential by components (innovative, technological, economic) has been performed. The assessment of the regions readiness for the innovative systems and technologies implementation and the transport and logistics cluster creation has been presented. A technique for localization selection of intelligent transport technologies in the regions has been developed, as a base for organizing a transport and logistics cluster.

articleTitle: Research and Improvement of the Current Management of the Job Rhythms of the Intellectual Complex Excavator – Dump Truck in the Adjacent Faces
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The decline in the quality of the extracted mineral raw materials amid the rise in price of material and energy resources determines the need to search for new reserves to improve the efficiency of the mining and processing enterprises. Under these conditions, there is no alternative to technical modernization on the basis of an increase in the unit capacity of the mining transport equipment, the robotization of the processes of the explosive separation of a part of ore from the massif in the block with its simultaneous fragmentation, loading and transportation of rock mass. At the same time, the variability of mining and geological and mining conditions does not allow for a significant increase in the utilization rates of modern mining transport complexes. To ensure the profitability of mining operations, we need intelligent loading and transport complexes that ensure the rhythm of work due to the ability to respond adequately to changing mining and technical conditions.

Author Keywords: algorithms for complete and incomplete cycles of excavation

articleTitle: Mastering Interpersonal and Virtual Communication Skills of the Education Process Participants in E-learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Social communication is carried out in two environments - real (interpersonal communication) and electronic (virtual communication). Both types of communication have become essential nowadays for specialists. Therefore, education should focus on mastering universal communicative competence. Online education is favorable for mastering both interpersonal and virtual communication skills of all the educational process participants. The article investigates a way to master communicative skills of two groups of education process participants. The first group incorporates learners, educators and parents who traditionally interact in the educational process. The second group involves interacting representatives of different cultures, and it becomes the feature of a teacher-student interaction in internationalization of tertiary education. The article gives theoretical background of the research studying different kinds of communication of education process participants in online learning environment, identifies the specific character of their communication and provides evidence that e-learning impacts the mastering of communicative skills for both groups of participants.

articleTitle: Genetic Algoritms for the Synthesis of Innovative Engineering Solutions
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: An intelligent system for the synthesis of compound objects is described. This system is based on the approach using natural evolution mechanisms to combine elements and to select viable solutions. A complete object is generated from a set of elements only if their mutual internal requirements are satisfied. The knowledge of experts represented as rules and functions is applied to form descriptions of generated objects. Selection of the best solutions is based on the generalized measure of similarity to the task that should be satisfied by the synthesized objects. The system allows the generation of solutions that have no internal contradictions and satisfy external requirements.
